resale_co.name: Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO) for a Residential Resale
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Clementon Code Enforcement Office
requirements: House number at least 4 inches high, visible from the street
Steps and walkways without trip hazards; cracked sidewalk blocks with a height change replaced
Guardrails where a porch, landing or stairs is over 30 inches above grade; handrail on steps with 4 or more risers
Yard free of high grass, weeds, dead trees, debris and hazards
Gutters and downspouts attached and clear, with splash blocks or diverters
Basement/crawl space openings and exterior doors secure and weatherproof; sump pump discharge outside, not into the sanitary sewer
No signs of pests (otherwise a licensed pest control certification is needed)
Bathroom window or exhaust fan; GFI protection on existing bathroom, kitchen counter, garage and exterior outlets
Cover plates on all switches and outlets; electrical panel secure, labeled, no open breaker slots; A/C disconnect at the outdoor unit
Windows intact; bedroom windows open and close for emergency escape
Water heater relief valve with discharge pipe ending 2 to 6 inches above the floor; tight flue connections
No plumbing leaks; fixtures and toilets secure
Work done without permits will be cited; open permits must be closed out

fees.label: 1 and 2 family house or condo ($60 / $120; form does not say which applies to which, likely $60 for one unit and $120 for two)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the CCO Application for a Residential Resale (linked as 'RESALE CO INSPECTION FORM' on the Code Enforcement page), fill it out (seller, buyer, closing date, contacts) and submit it to Code Enforcement, Borough of Clementon, 101 Gibbsboro Road, Clementon, NJ 08021, with the fee (the form records a money order or check number).

resale_co.notes: Two versions of the same form are posted: a text PDF uploaded 2021-04 (linked from the Code Enforcement page) and a scanned copy uploaded 2025-03 (linked from the Forms page). Both show the same fees. The Code Enforcement page now names Nick Sapio as Code Enforcement Officer/Zoning Officer (fax 856-545-7392). The Borough code on ecode360 (CL0179) has a rental CO chapter (Chapter 96) but no resale CCO section was found, so the Borough page and form are the sources. No lead time or validity period is published. Rental CO and rental registration are separate programs.

requirements: Working smoke alarm installed per NFPA 74 and N.J.A.C. 5:70-4.19, listed to ANSI/UL 217, following the Borough's requirement chart
All single-station smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery alarms (effective January 1, 2019); AC-powered alarms from original construction cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Working carbon monoxide alarm outside each separate sleeping area, in the immediate vicinity of the bedrooms

Homes with a secondary power source (generator, solar panels, battery storage) need a Secondary Power Source Identification Label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and electric meter (ANSI Z535.4)
Visible address in numbers or letters at least 3 inches high, contrasting color, on the street side

fire_cert.notes: Changed since the last check: the Borough rewrote its Fire Safety page (updated October 14, 2026) and replaced the application PDF at the same address. The certificate is now called a Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Secondary Power Source Labeling Compliance (CSACMASPSC). The fire extinguisher, the year-built smoke alarm chart wording and the line 'Certificates are valid for 6 months' are no longer on the posted form, so the extinguisher has been dropped from the requirements and no validity period is listed. Fees are unchanged ($60, $100, $161, $200; re-inspection $35) and match Borough code Section 134-7, which also lists a separate $35 certificate of fire code status form fee (not part of the resale certificate). Fees are quoted from the Fire Safety web page; the PDF form is a scanned image. Clerical contact on the Fire Safety page: Philip Beehler (pbeehler@clementon-nj.com). The DCA registry lists Clementon as a municipal (M) fire code enforcing agency.

other_items.label: Open permits must be closed
other_items.detail: Any permits without final inspections or a Certificate of Approval must be closed out; contact the borough beforehand to ask if the address has anything open. Work done without permits will be cited.

open_questions: The CCO form lists '$60/$120' for 1 and 2 family homes without saying which amount applies to which; confirm with Code Enforcement.
No CCO lead time or validity period is published.
How long is the smoke/CO certificate valid? The new form no longer says.
